title: Path With Maximum Minimum Value
summary: Given an m x n matrix of integers, find the highest minimum value along any path from the top-left to the bottom-right corner, moving only up, down, left, or right.
statement: Given an m x n matrix of integers, find the highest minimum value along any path from the top-left to the bottom-right corner, moving only up, down, left, or right.
constraints: Move four-directionally from top-left to bottom-right.
Maximize the minimum cell value encountered along the path.
hints: This is a widest-path problem: a partial path is ranked by its minimum value.
Use a max-heap and finalize cells in descending path score.
A neighbor score is min(current score,neighbor value); return when the destination is popped.
The heap ensures no later path can improve a popped cell’s bottleneck score.
editorial: The heap ensures no later path can improve a popped cell’s bottleneck score.

tests.explanation: A path whose minimum is four is optimal.
The best path must touch value two until the destination, scoring two.
